$comment: Preset catalogue for the map quiz. Edit this file, re-run `node tools/geo/build.mjs`,
commit the output. Nothing here is read at runtime — the build emits public/geo/manifest.json,
which is what the app loads.
detail      : which Natural Earth scale to pull source files from (110m | 50m | 10m)
bbox        : [west, south, east, north] in degrees. Omit to use bboxFrom.
bboxFrom    : derive the bbox from a country polygon (see below). padDeg widens it.
simplify    : mapshaper vertex-retention percentage. Lower = fewer squiggles = smaller.
precision   : coordinate rounding in degrees. 0.001 ~= 111 m. 0.0005 ~= 55 m.
riverRank   : keep rivers with scalerank <= this. Higher = more, smaller rivers.
lakeRank    : keep lakes with scalerank <= this.
layers      : which layer keys to build. See LAYERS in build.mjs for the catalogue.
focus       : required only if a layer uses the 'focus' key or bboxFrom.
